"""Тесты создания брони и прав доступа."""

from datetime import timedelta

from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.test import APITestCase
from rest_framework_simplejwt.tokens import RefreshToken

from catalog.models import Book, BookCopy
from loans.models import Loan, LoanStatusHistory
from loans.statuses import LoanStatus
from reservations.models import Reservation
from users.models import ActivityLog, User

LOANS_URL = "/api/loans/"
PASSWORD = "StrongPass123!"


def make_user(email, role=User.Role.READER):
    return User.objects.create_user(
        email=email, password=PASSWORD, full_name="Тестовый Читатель", role=role
    )


def make_book(title="Тестовая книга", is_active=True):
    return Book.objects.create(
        title=title, author="Тестовый Автор", genre="Роман", is_active=is_active
    )


def make_copy(book, number="INV-T-001", is_active=True):
    return BookCopy.objects.create(
        book=book, inventory_number=number, is_active=is_active
    )


def make_loan(copy, reader, start, due, status=LoanStatus.CREATED):
    return Loan.objects.create(
        reader=reader, copy=copy, start_date=start, due_date=due, status=status
    )


class LoanCreateApiTests(APITestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.today = timezone.localdate()
        self.book = make_book()
        self.copy = make_copy(self.book)
        self.reader = make_user("reader@test.local")
        self.other_reader = make_user("other@test.local")
        self.librarian = make_user("librarian@test.local", role=User.Role.LIBRARIAN)
        self.authenticate(self.reader)

    def authenticate(self, user):
        token = RefreshToken.for_user(user).access_token
        self.client.credentials(HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=f"Bearer {token}")

    def post_loan(self, **payload):
        return self.client.post(LOANS_URL, payload, format="json")

    def test_create_loan_defaults_to_14_days(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id, start_date=start.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["due_date"], (start + timedelta(days=14)).isoformat())
        self.assertEqual(response.data["status"], LoanStatus.CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["reader_id"], self.reader.id)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["book"]["title"], self.book.title)

        loan = Loan.objects.get(pk=response.data["id"])
        self.assertEqual(loan.reader, self.reader)
        self.assertEqual(loan.due_date, start + timedelta(days=14))

    def test_create_loan_with_explicit_due_date(self):
        start = self.today
        due = self.today + timedelta(days=10)

        response = self.post_loan(
            copy_id=self.copy.id,
            start_date=start.isoformat(),
            due_date=due.isoformat(),
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["due_date"], due.isoformat())

    def test_due_date_can_be_exactly_30_days(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        due = start + timedelta(days=30)

        response = self.post_loan(
            copy_id=self.copy.id,
            start_date=start.isoformat(),
            due_date=due.isoformat(),
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    def test_due_date_over_30_days_rejected(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        due = start + timedelta(days=31)

        response = self.post_loan(
            copy_id=self.copy.id,
            start_date=start.isoformat(),
            due_date=due.isoformat(),
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "invalid_period")
        self.assertFalse(Loan.objects.exists())

    def test_start_date_in_past_rejected(self):
        start = self.today - timedelta(days=1)

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id, start_date=start.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "invalid_period")
        self.assertFalse(Loan.objects.exists())

    def test_due_date_before_start_rejected(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=5)
        due = start - timedelta(days=1)

        response = self.post_loan(
            copy_id=self.copy.id,
            start_date=start.isoformat(),
            due_date=due.isoformat(),
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "invalid_period")

    def test_overlapping_loan_returns_copy_taken(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        make_loan(self.copy, self.other_reader, start, start + timedelta(days=10))

        response = self.post_loan(
            copy_id=self.copy.id,
            start_date=(start + timedelta(days=5)).isoformat(),
            due_date=(start + timedelta(days=15)).isoformat(),
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "copy_taken")
        self.assertEqual(Loan.objects.filter(copy=self.copy).count(), 1)

    def test_adjacent_intervals_allowed(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        first_due = start + timedelta(days=10)
        make_loan(self.copy, self.other_reader, start, first_due)

        response = self.post_loan(
            copy_id=self.copy.id,
            start_date=first_due.isoformat(),
            due_date=(first_due + timedelta(days=10)).isoformat(),
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    def test_cancelled_loan_does_not_block_copy(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        make_loan(
            self.copy,
            self.other_reader,
            start,
            start + timedelta(days=10),
            status=LoanStatus.CANCELLED,
        )

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id, start_date=start.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    def test_returned_loan_does_not_block_copy(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        make_loan(
            self.copy,
            self.other_reader,
            start,
            start + timedelta(days=10),
            status=LoanStatus.RETURNED,
        )

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id, start_date=start.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    def test_book_id_picks_free_copy(self):
        second_copy = make_copy(self.book, number="INV-T-002")
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        make_loan(self.copy, self.other_reader, start, start + timedelta(days=10))

        response = self.post_loan(book_id=self.book.id, start_date=start.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["copy_id"], second_copy.id)

    def test_no_free_copies_returns_no_copies(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        make_loan(self.copy, self.other_reader, start, start + timedelta(days=10))

        response = self.post_loan(book_id=self.book.id, start_date=start.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "no_copies")
        self.assertEqual(Loan.objects.count(), 1)

    def test_inactive_copy_returns_no_copies(self):
        self.copy.is_active = False
        self.copy.save(update_fields=["is_active"])

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "no_copies")
        self.assertFalse(Loan.objects.exists())

    def test_inactive_book_returns_no_copies(self):
        self.book.is_active = False
        self.book.save(update_fields=["is_active"])

        response = self.post_loan(book_id=self.book.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "no_copies")

    def test_other_reader_hold_blocks_copy(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        Reservation.objects.create(
            book=self.book,
            reader=self.other_reader,
            status=Reservation.Status.READY,
            hold_copy=self.copy,
            hold_until=timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=48),
        )

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id, start_date=start.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "copy_taken")

    def test_expired_hold_does_not_block_copy(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        Reservation.objects.create(
            book=self.book,
            reader=self.other_reader,
            status=Reservation.Status.READY,
            hold_copy=self.copy,
            hold_until=timezone.now() - timedelta(hours=1),
        )

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id, start_date=start.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    def test_own_hold_does_not_block_reader(self):
        start = self.today + timedelta(days=1)
        Reservation.objects.create(
            book=self.book,
            reader=self.reader,
            status=Reservation.Status.READY,
            hold_copy=self.copy,
            hold_until=timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=48),
        )

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id, start_date=start.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)

    def test_reader_is_taken_from_jwt_not_from_body(self):
        response = self.post_loan(
            copy_id=self.copy.id,
            reader_id=self.other_reader.id,
            reader=self.other_reader.id,
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        loan = Loan.objects.get(pk=response.data["id"])
        self.assertEqual(loan.reader, self.reader)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["reader_id"], self.reader.id)

    def test_creates_history_and_activity_log(self):
        response = self.post_loan(
            copy_id=self.copy.id,
            start_date=(self.today + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat(),
            comment="Нужна для курсовой",
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        loan = Loan.objects.get(pk=response.data["id"])
        self.assertEqual(loan.comment, "Нужна для курсовой")

        history = LoanStatusHistory.objects.get(loan=loan)
        self.assertEqual(history.old_status, "")
        self.assertEqual(history.new_status, LoanStatus.CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(history.changed_by, self.reader)

        log = ActivityLog.objects.get(action=ActivityLog.Action.LOAN_CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(log.user, self.reader)
        self.assertEqual(log.entity_type, "loan")
        self.assertEqual(log.entity_id, loan.id)

    def test_book_not_found(self):
        response = self.post_loan(book_id=999999)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "not_found")

    def test_copy_not_found(self):
        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=999999)

        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "not_found")

    def test_target_is_required(self):
        response = self.post_loan(start_date=self.today.isoformat())

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "target_required")

    def test_invalid_field_format_returns_validation_error(self):
        response = self.post_loan(copy_id="not-a-number")

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "validation_error")
        self.assertIn("copy_id", response.data["fields"])

    def test_anonymous_cannot_create_loan(self):
        self.client.credentials()

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)
        self.assertFalse(Loan.objects.exists())

    def test_librarian_cannot_create_loan(self):
        self.authenticate(self.librarian)

        response = self.post_loan(copy_id=self.copy.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
        self.assertFalse(Loan.objects.exists())

"""Тест конкурентности: 10 одновременных бронирований одного экземпляра.

Проверка имеет смысл только на MySQL: SQLite сериализует записи и не
доказывает работу `select_for_update`. Запуск:
    python manage.py test loans.tests.test_concurrency -v 2
"""

import threading

from django.db import close_old_connections
from django.test import TransactionTestCase
from rest_framework.test import APIClient
from rest_framework_simplejwt.tokens import RefreshToken

from catalog.models import Book, BookCopy
from loans.models import Loan, LoanStatusHistory
from users.models import ActivityLog, User

LOANS_URL = "/api/loans/"
THREADS = 10


class ConcurrentBookingTests(TransactionTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.book = Book.objects.create(
            title="Гонка за книгой", author="Тестовый Автор", genre="Роман"
        )
        self.copy = BookCopy.objects.create(
            book=self.book, inventory_number="INV-RACE-001"
        )
        self.reader = User.objects.create_user(
            email="race@test.local", password="StrongPass123!", full_name="Читатель Гонки"
        )
        self.access = str(RefreshToken.for_user(self.reader).access_token)

    def book_copy(self):
        client = APIClient()
        client.credentials(HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=f"Bearer {self.access}")
        return client.post(
            LOANS_URL,
            {"copy_id": self.copy.id, "start_date": "2030-01-10"},
            format="json",
        )

    def test_ten_parallel_requests_create_exactly_one_loan(self):
        results = []
        errors = []
        lock = threading.Lock()
        barrier = threading.Barrier(THREADS)

        def worker():
            close_old_connections()
            try:
                barrier.wait(timeout=20)
                response = self.book_copy()
                with lock:
                    results.append((response.status_code, response.data.get("code")))
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 — нужен текст для диагностики
                with lock:
                    errors.append(repr(error))
            finally:
                close_old_connections()

        threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker) for _ in range(THREADS)]
        for thread in threads:
            thread.start()
        for thread in threads:
            thread.join(timeout=60)

        self.assertFalse(errors, f"Ошибки в потоках: {errors}")
        self.assertEqual(len(results), THREADS)

        statuses = [status_code for status_code, _ in results]
        self.assertEqual(statuses.count(201), 1, f"Ответы: {results}")
        self.assertEqual(statuses.count(409), THREADS - 1, f"Ответы: {results}")

        for status_code, code in results:
            if status_code == 409:
                self.assertEqual(code, "copy_taken")

        self.assertEqual(Loan.objects.filter(copy=self.copy).count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(LoanStatusHistory.objects.count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            ActivityLog.objects.filter(action=ActivityLog.Action.LOAN_CREATED).count(), 1
        )

"""Демонстрация защиты от двойной выдачи на MySQL.

Запускает 10 параллельных HTTP-запросов на бронирование одного экземпляра
и показывает, что срабатывает ровно один. Требуется запущенный сервер:

    python manage.py runserver
    python scripts/concurrent_booking.py

Параметры: --base-url, --email, --password, --threads, --copy-id, --keep.
По умолчанию тестовая бронь удаляется, чтобы демонстрацию можно было
повторять; с --keep она остаётся в базе.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import sys
import threading
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from datetime import timedelta
from pathlib import Path

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE_DIR))
os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "config.settings")

import django  # noqa: E402

django.setup()

from django.db import connection  # noqa: E402
from django.utils import timezone  # noqa: E402

from catalog.models import BookCopy  # noqa: E402
from loans.models import Loan, LoanStatusHistory  # noqa: E402
from loans.statuses import BLOCKING_STATUSES  # noqa: E402
from reservations.models import Reservation  # noqa: E402
from users.models import ActivityLog  # noqa: E402

DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
DEMO_OFFSET_DAYS = 120
DEFAULT_THREADS = 10


def request_json(method, url, payload=None, token=None):
    body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8") if payload is not None else None
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method=method)
    request.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        request.add_header("Authorization", f"Bearer {token}")

    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
            raw = response.read().decode("utf-8")
            return response.status, json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        raw = error.read().decode("utf-8")
        return error.code, json.loads(raw) if raw else None


def login(base_url, email, password):
    status, data = request_json(
        "POST", f"{base_url}/api/auth/login/", {"email": email, "password": password}
    )
    if status != 200 or not data:
        raise SystemExit(f"Не удалось войти ({status}): {data}")
    return data["access"]


def find_free_copy(start, due):
    now = timezone.now()
    copies = (
        BookCopy.objects.filter(is_active=True, book__is_active=True)
        .select_related("book")
        .order_by("pk")
    )
    for copy in copies:
        busy = Loan.objects.filter(
            copy=copy,
            status__in=BLOCKING_STATUSES,
            start_date__lt=due,
            due_date__gt=start,
        ).exists()
        if busy:
            continue
        held = Reservation.objects.filter(
            hold_copy=copy,
            status=Reservation.Status.READY,
            hold_until__gt=now,
        ).exists()
        if not held:
            return copy
    raise SystemExit("Не нашлось свободного экземпляра для демонстрации")


def run_requests(url, token, payload, threads):
    barrier = threading.Barrier(threads)
    results = []
    lock = threading.Lock()

    def worker():
        barrier.wait(timeout=30)
        status, body = request_json("POST", url, payload, token)
        with lock:
            results.append(
                (
                    status,
                    (body or {}).get("code"),
                    (body or {}).get("id"),
                    (body or {}).get("detail"),
                )
            )

    workers = [threading.Thread(target=worker) for _ in range(threads)]
    for worker_thread in workers:
        worker_thread.start()
    for worker_thread in workers:
        worker_thread.join(timeout=60)
    return results


def cleanup(loan_id):
    LoanStatusHistory.objects.filter(loan_id=loan_id).delete()
    ActivityLog.objects.filter(entity_type="loan", entity_id=loan_id).delete()
    Loan.objects.filter(pk=loan_id).delete()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--base-url", default=DEFAULT_BASE_URL)
    parser.add_argument("--email", default="reader1@library.local")
    parser.add_argument("--password", default="demo12345")
    parser.add_argument("--threads", type=int, default=DEFAULT_THREADS)
    parser.add_argument("--copy-id", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true", help="не удалять тестовую бронь")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if connection.vendor != "mysql":
        raise SystemExit("Скрипт рассчитан только на MySQL: SQLite не проверяет гонку")

    today = timezone.localdate()
    start = today + timedelta(days=DEMO_OFFSET_DAYS)
    due = start + timedelta(days=14)

    if args.copy_id:
        copy = BookCopy.objects.select_related("book").get(pk=args.copy_id)
    else:
        copy = find_free_copy(start, due)

    token = login(args.base_url, args.email, args.password)

    print("Демонстрация конкурентного бронирования")
    print(f"БД: MySQL, экземпляр: {copy.inventory_number} «{copy.book.title}»")
    print(f"Период: {start:%d.%m.%Y} — {due:%d.%m.%Y}, потоков: {args.threads}")
    print()

    payload = {"copy_id": copy.id, "start_date": start.isoformat()}
    results = run_requests(f"{args.base_url}/api/loans/", token, payload, args.threads)

    for status, code, loan_id, detail in results:
        tail = code or detail or ""
        print(f"  {status}  {tail}")

    created = [item for item in results if item[0] == 201]
    conflicts = [item for item in results if item[0] == 409]
    loans_in_db = Loan.objects.filter(
        copy=copy, start_date=start, due_date=due
    ).count()

    print()
    print(f"201 Created: {len(created)}, 409 Conflict: {len(conflicts)}")
    print(f"Броней в базе на этот интервал: {loans_in_db}")

    ok = (
        len(created) == 1
        and len(conflicts) == args.threads - 1
        and loans_in_db == 1
        and all(item[1] == "copy_taken" for item in conflicts)
    )
    print("Вердикт:", "OK — двойной выдачи нет" if ok else "ОШИБКА — проверьте блокировку")

    if created and not args.keep:
        cleanup(created[0][2])
        print("Тестовая бронь удалена (используйте --keep, чтобы оставить).")

    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

## Objective
- Продолжить учебный проект «Библиотека» (React 18 + Vite, Django 5 + DRF, MySQL, JWT): сейчас реализовать каталог книг (API + экраны `/catalog`, `/books/:id`), не ломая уже готовое бронирование.

## Requirements
- Каталог backend: `GET /api/books/` (список), поиск по названию и автору, фильтр по жанру, серверная пагинация, `GET /api/books/{id}/`, количество свободных экземпляров, CRUD книг и экземпляров только для администратора, неактивные книги не отображаются.
- Доступность: `GET /api/books/{id}/availability/` с `start_date` и `due_date`; учитывать активные брони и действующие удержания, пересечения дат.
- Frontend: `/catalog` и `/books/:id`; поиск, фильтры, пагинация; обложка, автор, жанр, доступность.
- Написать тесты поиска, фильтров, пагинации, прав доступа и корректности расчёта свободных экземпляров.
- «Не переходи к созданию бронирований. Сначала закончи каталог» — брони уже реализованы ранее, новые функции брони сейчас не добавлять; «подстрой всё из прошлого, чтобы с этим всё тоже работало за компанию».
- Ранее: frontend CSS отдельно, простой аккуратный интерфейс, не дублировать запросы в компонентах, состояния загрузки/пустоты/ошибки с повтором.

## Decisions
- Токены в `localStorage`: `library.access`, `library.refresh`; refresh single-flight в `api/client.js`.
- Демо-пароль всех аккаунтов — `demo12345`; API — `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api`, frontend — `http://localhost:5173`.
- React зафиксирован на 18.3.1 (шаблон Vite ставил 19), `react-router-dom` 7.18.5, Vite 8.
- Даты брони: backend считает `due_date` (+14 дней по умолчанию, максимум 30), `start_date` не в прошлом; пересечение `start_date < new_due AND due_date > new_start`.
- Бронь: читатель только из JWT, `select_for_update()` первым запросом транзакции, коды `copy_taken` / `no_copies`.
- Для каталога предполагается переиспользовать те же правила занятости, что в `loans/services.py` (создавать/active + действующие `ready`-удержания).

## Work State
### Completed
- Backend auth: 5 JWT-эндпоинтов, `activity_log`, роли, blacklist refresh, 19 тестов.
- Модели `Book`, `BookCopy`, `Loan`, `LoanStatusHistory`, `Reservation`; индексы; миграции.
- `seed_demo`: 14 пользователей, 20 книг, 30 экземпляров, 45 броней, 5 заявок (1 ready + 4 waiting).
- Frontend авторизации: router, `client.js`, `AuthContext`, `ProtectedRoute`/`PublicOnlyRoute`, `/login`, `/register`, защищённая заглушка `/`; 17 браузерных проверок, build и lint чистые.

155:     def create_loans(self, copies):
156:         today = timezone.localdate()
157:         base = today - timedelta(days=120)
158:         readers = list(User.objects.filter(role=User.Role.READER).order_by("email"))
159:         librarian = User.objects.filter(role=User.Role.LIBRARIAN).order_by("email").first()
160: 
161:         if not readers:
162:             return
163: 
164:         def add_loan(copy, reader, start, due, status):
165:             loan, created = Loan.objects.get_or_create(
166:                 copy=copy,
167:                 start_date=start,
168:                 defaults={
169:                     "reader": reader,
170:                     "due_date": due,
171:                     "status": status,
172:                 },
173:             )
174:             if created:
175:                 self.add_history(loan, status, librarian)
176:             return loan

178:         # 30 исторических броней: по одной на экземпляр и вторая для первых десяти.
179:         for index, copy in enumerate(copies):
180:             start = base + timedelta(days=index * 2)
181:             status = LoanStatus.CANCELLED if index % 6 == 0 else LoanStatus.RETURNED
182:             add_loan(copy, readers[index % len(readers)], start, start + timedelta(days=10), status)
183: 
184:         for index, copy in enumerate(copies[:10]):
185:             start = base + timedelta(days=index * 2 + 20)
186:             add_loan(
187:                 copy,

189:                 start,
190:                 start + timedelta(days=10),
191:                 LoanStatus.RETURNED,
192:             )
193: 
194:         # Текущие выдачи и новые брони — на свободные экземпляры.
195:         for index, copy in enumerate(copies[:3]):

197:                 copy,
198:                 readers[(index + 1) % len(readers)],
199:                 today - timedelta(days=2),
200:                 today + timedelta(days=12),
201:                 LoanStatus.ACTIVE,
202:             )
203:         for index, copy in enumerate(copies[3:5]):
204:             add_loan(
205:                 copy,
206:                 readers[(index + 5) % len(readers)],
207:                 today + timedelta(days=1),
208:                 today + timedelta(days=15),
209:                 LoanStatus.CREATED,
210:             )

"""Расчёт занятости экземпляров на интервал.

Правила совпадают с `loans/services.py`: экземпляр занят, если на даты
пересекается бронь в статусе `created`/`active` или действует чужое
удержание `ready`. Смежные интервалы не конфликтуют.
"""

from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import timedelta

from django.utils import timezone

from catalog.models import BookCopy
from loans.models import Loan
from loans.statuses import BLOCKING_STATUSES
from reservations.models import Reservation

DEFAULT_AVAILABILITY_DAYS = 14


def current_period():
    """Интервал «свободно сейчас» для списка и карточки."""
    today = timezone.localdate()
    return today, today + timedelta(days=1)


def busy_copy_ids(copy_ids, start_date, due_date, reader=None):
    """Экземпляры из списка, занятые на интервал."""
    copy_ids = list(copy_ids)
    if not copy_ids:
        return set()

    loan_copy_ids = Loan.objects.filter(
        copy_id__in=copy_ids,
        status__in=BLOCKING_STATUSES,
        start_date__lt=due_date,
        due_date__gt=start_date,
    ).values_list("copy_id", flat=True)

    holds = Reservation.objects.filter(
        hold_copy_id__in=copy_ids,
        status=Reservation.Status.READY,
        hold_until__gt=timezone.now(),
    )
    if reader is not None and getattr(reader, "is_authenticated", False):
        # Своё удержание не мешает читателю оформить бронь.
        holds = holds.exclude(reader=reader)
    hold_copy_ids = holds.values_list("hold_copy_id", flat=True)

    return set(loan_copy_ids) | set(hold_copy_ids)


def attach_counts(books, start_date, due_date, reader=None):
    """Проставить книгам `total_copies`, `free_copies` и `busy_copies`.

    Один запрос за экземплярами и один за занятыми — без запросов на книгу.
    """
    books = list(books)
    if not books:
        return books

    copies = list(
        BookCopy.objects.filter(
            book_id__in=[book.id for book in books], is_active=True
        ).values("id", "book_id")
    )
    copies_by_book = defaultdict(list)
    for copy in copies:
        copies_by_book[copy["book_id"]].append(copy["id"])

    busy = busy_copy_ids(
        [copy["id"] for copy in copies], start_date, due_date, reader
    )

    for book in books:
        copy_ids = copies_by_book.get(book.id, [])
        free_ids = [copy_id for copy_id in copy_ids if copy_id not in busy]
        book.total_copies = len(copy_ids)
        book.free_copies = len(free_ids)
        book.busy_copies = len(copy_ids) - len(free_ids)
        book.free_copy_ids = free_ids
        book.counts_attached = True

    return books


def describe(book, start_date, due_date, reader=None):
    """Полная доступность книги: счётчики и список активных экземпляров."""
    copies = list(book.copies.filter(is_active=True).order_by("inventory_number"))
    busy = busy_copy_ids(
        [copy.id for copy in copies], start_date, due_date, reader
    )

    items = [
        {
            "id": copy.id,
            "inventory_number": copy.inventory_number,
            "condition": copy.condition,
            "is_available": copy.id not in busy,
        }
        for copy in copies
    ]
    free_items = [item for item in items if item["is_available"]]

    return {
        "total_copies": len(items),
        "free_copies": len(free_items),
        "busy_copies": len(items) - len(free_items),
        "is_available": bool(free_items),
        "available_copies": free_items,
        "copies": items,
    }

"""Список каталога: поиск, фильтр, пагинация, счётчики."""

from datetime import timedelta

from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.test import APITestCase

from catalog.tests.utils import (
    AuthMixin,
    find_book,
    make_book,
    make_copy,
    make_hold,
    make_loan,
    make_user,
)
from loans.statuses import LoanStatus

BOOKS_URL = "/api/books/"


class CatalogListTests(AuthMixin, APITestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.today = timezone.localdate()
        self.reader = make_user("reader@test.local")
        self.other = make_user("other@test.local")
        self.authenticate(self.reader)

    def get_list(self, **params):
        return self.client.get(BOOKS_URL, params)

    def test_anonymous_cannot_read_catalog(self):
        self.client.credentials()

        response = self.get_list()

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "unauthorized")

    def test_search_by_title(self):
        book = make_book(title="Мастер и Маргарита", author="Михаил Булгаков")
        make_book(title="1984", author="Джордж Оруэлл", genre="Антиутопия")

        response = self.get_list(search="Маргарита")

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["results"][0]["id"], book.id)

    def test_search_by_author(self):
        book = make_book(title="Солярис", author="Станислав Лем", genre="Фантастика")
        make_book(title="1984", author="Джордж Оруэлл", genre="Антиутопия")

        response = self.get_list(search="Лем")

        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["results"][0]["id"], book.id)

    def test_search_without_matches_returns_empty_page(self):
        make_book(title="Мастер и Маргарита")

        response = self.get_list(search="нет такой книги")

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["results"], [])

    def test_genre_filter(self):
        novel = make_book(title="Анна Каренина", genre="Роман")
        make_book(title="Солярис", genre="Фантастика")

        response = self.get_list(genre="Роман")

        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["results"][0]["id"], novel.id)

    def test_search_and_genre_work_together(self):
        make_book(title="Мастер и Маргарита", genre="Роман")

        response = self.get_list(search="Мастер", genre="Фантастика")

        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 0)

    def test_inactive_books_are_hidden(self):
        active = make_book(title="Видимая книга")
        make_book(title="Скрытая книга", is_active=False)

        response = self.get_list()

        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["results"][0]["id"], active.id)

    def test_pagination_uses_page_size_nine(self):
        for index in range(10):
            make_book(title=f"Книга {index:02d}", author=f"Автор {index:02d}")
        make_book(title="Неактивная", is_active=False)

        first = self.get_list(page=1)
        second = self.get_list(page=2)

        self.assertEqual(first.data["count"], 10)
        self.assertEqual(len(first.data["results"]), 9)
        self.assertIsNotNone(first.data["next"])
        self.assertEqual(len(second.data["results"]), 1)
        self.assertIsNotNone(second.data["previous"])

    def test_list_shows_total_and_free_copies(self):
        book = make_book(title="Книга с экземплярами")
        first = make_copy(book, "INV-001")
        second = make_copy(book, "INV-002")
        third = make_copy(book, "INV-003")
        make_copy(book, "INV-004")

        make_loan(
            first,
            self.other,
            self.today - timedelta(days=1),
            self.today + timedelta(days=5),
            status=LoanStatus.ACTIVE,
        )
        make_loan(
            second,
            self.other,
            self.today - timedelta(days=1),
            self.today + timedelta(days=5),
            status=LoanStatus.RETURNED,
        )
        make_loan(
            third,
            self.other,
            self.today + timedelta(days=5),
            self.today + timedelta(days=15),
            status=LoanStatus.CREATED,
        )

        response = self.get_list()
        item = find_book(response.data["results"], book.id)

        self.assertEqual(item["total_copies"], 4)
        self.assertEqual(item["free_copies"], 3)

    def test_inactive_copies_are_not_counted(self):
        book = make_book(title="Книга со списанным экземпляром")
        make_copy(book, "INV-001")
        make_copy(book, "INV-002", is_active=False)

        response = self.get_list()
        item = find_book(response.data["results"], book.id)

        self.assertEqual(item["total_copies"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(item["free_copies"], 1)

    def test_active_hold_reduces_free_copies(self):
        book = make_book(title="Книга с удержанием")
        held = make_copy(book, "INV-001")
        make_copy(book, "INV-002")
        make_hold(book, held, self.other)

        response = self.get_list()
        item = find_book(response.data["results"], book.id)

        self.assertEqual(item["total_copies"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(item["free_copies"], 1)

    def test_own_hold_does_not_hide_copy_from_reader(self):
        book = make_book(title="Моя книга")
        held = make_copy(book, "INV-001")
        make_hold(book, held, self.reader)

        response = self.get_list()
        item = find_book(response.data["results"], book.id)

        self.assertEqual(item["free_copies"], 1)

    def test_detail_contains_description_and_copy_states(self):
        book = make_book(title="Подробная книга")
        busy = make_copy(book, "INV-001")
        make_copy(book, "INV-002")
        make_loan(
            busy,
            self.other,
            self.today,
            self.today + timedelta(days=5),
            status=LoanStatus.ACTIVE,
        )

        response = self.client.get(f"{BOOKS_URL}{book.id}/")

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["title"], book.title)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["total_copies"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["free_copies"], 1)
        states = {copy["inventory_number"]: copy["is_available"] for copy in response.data["copies"]}
        self.assertEqual(states, {"INV-001": False, "INV-002": True})

    def test_genres_are_unique_and_only_active(self):
        make_book(title="Роман 1", genre="Роман")
        make_book(title="Роман 2", genre="Роман")
        make_book(title="Поэзия", genre="Поэзия")
        make_book(title="Скрытый детектив", genre="Детектив", is_active=False)

        response = self.client.get(f"{BOOKS_URL}genres/")

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["genres"], ["Поэзия", "Роман"])

## Objective
- Продолжить учебный проект «Библиотека» (React 18 + Vite, Django 5 + DRF, MySQL, JWT): реализовать каталог книг (API + экраны `/catalog`, `/books/:id`), не ломая уже готовое бронирование.

## Requirements
- Каталог backend: `GET /api/books/` (список), поиск по названию и автору, фильтр по жанру, серверная пагинация, `GET /api/books/{id}/`, количество свободных экземпляров, CRUD книг и экземпляров только для администратора, неактивные книги не отображаются.
- Доступность: `GET /api/books/{id}/availability/` с `start_date` и `due_date`; учитывать активные брони и действующие удержания, пересечения дат.
- Frontend: `/catalog` и `/books/:id`; поиск, фильтры, пагинация; обложка, автор, жанр, доступность.
- Написать тесты поиска, фильтров, пагинации, прав доступа и корректности расчёта свободных экземпляров.
- «Не переходи к созданию бронирований. Сначала закончи каталог» — новые функции брони сейчас не добавлять; «подстрой всё из прошлого, чтобы с этим всё тоже работало за компанию».
- Ранее: frontend CSS отдельно, простой аккуратный интерфейс, не дублировать запросы в компонентах, состояния загрузки/пустоты/ошибки с повтором.

## Decisions
- Токены в `localStorage`: `library.access`, `library.refresh`; refresh single-flight в `api/client.js`.
- Демо-пароль всех аккаунтов — `demo12345`; API — `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api`, frontend — `http://localhost:5173`.
- React зафиксирован на 18.3.1, `react-router-dom` 7.18.5, Vite 8.
- Даты брони: backend считает `due_date` (+14 дней, максимум 30), `start_date` не в прошлом; пересечение `start_date < new_due AND due_date > new_start`.
- Каталог переиспользует правила занятости из `loans/services.py`: брони `created`/`active`, чужие действующие `ready`-удержания (`hold_until > now`), смежные интервалы не конфликтуют, своё удержание не блокирует.
- Список и detail показывают «свободно сейчас» (интервал сегодня → завтра); `/availability/` по умолчанию — 14 дней, проверяет период через `loans.services.resolve_period`.
- После входа по умолчанию открывается `/catalog`; общий header вынесен в `SiteHeader`.
- Ошибки каталога в формате `{"detail","code"}`; коды `validation_error`, `not_found`, `forbidden`, `unauthorized`, `invalid_period`, `book_in_use`, `copy_in_use`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Backend auth, JWT, роли, `activity_log`, модели фонда/броней/очереди, `seed_demo`, бронирование с `select_for_update`, конкурентный тест на 10 потоков и скрипт на MySQL — всё было готово ранее, 45 тестов зелёные.
- Каталог backend реализован: `catalog/availability.py`, `catalog/serializers.py`, `catalog/views.py`, `catalog/urls.py`, `IsAdminOrReadOnly` в `users/permissions.py`, подключение в `config/urls.py`.
- Эндпоинты: список с `search`, `genre`, `include_inactive` для админа, пагинация 9; detail с описанием/экземплярами/счётчиками; `availability`; `genres`; CRUD книг; вложенные `/books/{id}/copies/` и `/books/{book_id}/copies/{pk}/`; запрет удаления книги/экземпляра с историей броней.
- Тесты каталога: 60 тестов в `catalog/tests/` (список/поиск/фильтр/пагинация/счётчики, права и CRUD, доступность, границы, удержания, ошибки). Полный прогон: **105 тестов OK**.
- Frontend каталога готов: `api/books.js`, `SiteHeader`, `BookCover`, `AvailabilityBadge`, `Pagination`, `CatalogPage`, `BookDetailPage`; маршруты добавлены, `HomePage` переведён на общий header, `LoginPage` ведёт на `/catalog`.
- Стили: `styles/header.css`, `styles/catalog.css`, `styles/book.css`, общие `.book-cover`/`.availability` в `base.css`, header-стили убраны из `home.css`.
- `npm run lint` чистый, `npm run build` успешный.
- Backend и Vite dev-сервер запущены; Edge headless с CDP на порту 9222 запущен; создан e2e-скрипт `C:\Users\danil\AppData\Local\Temp\opencode\e2e_catalog.mjs`.
- В `docs/AI_LOG.md` записаны задачи 1–4 и ошибки агента; в `docs/PLAN.md` закрыты 2.3–2.4.

### Active
- E2E-проверка каталога в headless Edge запущена в фоне (`e2e_catalog.mjs`), результат ещё не получен: вход → каталог → поиск/жанр/пагинация → карточка → доступность → пустой поиск → reload → выход.
- После e2e нужно обновить `docs/AI_LOG.md` (задача №5) и отметить 2.1–2.2 в `docs/PLAN.md`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Дождаться результата `e2e_catalog.mjs`; при падении исправить UI/селекторы и перезапустить.
2. При необходимости вручную проверить живой API каталога на MySQL (reader/admin, доступность, CRUD с очисткой тестовых записей).
3. Обновить `docs/AI_LOG.md`: задача №5 о каталоге, результат 105 тестов + e2e, что исправлено (404-код через `Http404`, lint-предупреждения `set-state-in-effect`).
4. Отметить `docs/PLAN.md` 2.1–2.2 (`[x]`), записать итог недели при необходимости.
5. Остановить backend/Vite/Edge после проверки; при необходимости экспортировать сессию в `docs/prompts/`.

## Relevant Files
- `backend/catalog/availability.py`: расчёт занятости, `attach_counts`, `describe`, `busy_copy_ids`.
- `backend/catalog/views.py`: `BookViewSet`, `BookCopyDetailView`, `ApiErrorMixin`, availability/genres/copies actions.
- `backend/catalog/serializers.py`: list/detail/write/copy/availability-query сериализаторы.
- `backend/catalog/tests/`: `utils.py`, `test_catalog_list.py`, `test_access.py`, `test_availability.py`.
- `backend/users/permissions.py`: `IsAdminOrReadOnly`, `IsAdmin`, `IsReader`.
- `backend/config/urls.py`: подключение `catalog.urls` перед `loans.urls`.
- `frontend/src/pages/CatalogPage.jsx`: каталог, URL-фильтры, пагинация, состояния.
- `frontend/src/pages/BookDetailPage.jsx`: карточка, проверка доступности по датам, клиентская валидация.
- `frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.jsx`: общая шапка, навигация, выход.
- `frontend/src/api/books.js`: запросы каталога и `PAGE_SIZE = 9`.
- `frontend/src/styles/catalog.css`, `frontend/src/styles/book.css`, `frontend/src/styles/header.css`: стили новых экранов.
- `frontend/src/App.jsx`: маршруты `/catalog`, `/books/:id`.
- `docs/PLAN.md`, `docs/AI_LOG.md`: чекбоксы и журнал задач.

The date validation step failed. Why? Filling dates via the native setter: React's controlled input uses value and onChange. We fill start=isoDate(2), due=isoDate(1). Then submit. `validatePeriod` should return "Дата возврата должна быть позже даты начала". But no `.book-availability > .field__error` found.

Possible: the fills of start and due — after filling start, React re-renders; then fill due. The submit calls handleAvailabilitySubmit with state updated? The `period` state should have new values.

Wait: `min={period.startDate || todayISO()}` on due input. Setting a due date before min via native setter is allowed programmatically.

Hmm, but maybe the form submit was blocked by native HTML5 validation? Inputs are controlled by React but not `required` — no `required` attribute? Let me check: the date inputs have no `required` or `noValidate`. Browser constraint validation: `min` on inputs affects `:invalid` but submission is blocked only if `required` or pattern? Actually `min` violation makes input invalid, but form submission is blocked by constraint validation... For `<input type="date" min="...">` with a value below min, the input is in violation? Yes — rangeUnderflow applies, and since the input has a value and min, it's a candidate for constraint validation (barred only if disabled/readonly), so form submission is blocked and `submit` event not fired. That's likely it: due=isoDate(1) < min=isoDate(2) → browser blocks submission, so no client-side error text.

So this is actually a UI issue: browser blocks submit silently, no message. Better UX: add `noValidate` to the form so our own validation shows messages. Or don't set `min` dynamically on due? Keeping min is good UX. Add `noValidate` to form (React: `noValidate`). Then our validation message appears.

"""Ручная проверка API каталога на живом backend (MySQL)."""

import json
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from datetime import date, timedelta

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/api"
PASSWORD = "demo12345"
checks = []


def request(method, path, token=None, payload=None):
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(BASE + path, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    if token:
        req.add_header("Authorization", f"Bearer {token}")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as response:
            body = response.read().decode() or "null"
            return response.status, json.loads(body)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        body = error.read().decode() or "null"
        return error.code, json.loads(body)


def check(name, ok, extra=""):
    checks.append(ok)
    print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}  {name}{' — ' + str(extra) if extra else ''}")


def login(email):
    status, data = request("POST", "/auth/login/", payload={"email": email, "password": PASSWORD})
    assert status == 200, (status, data)
    return data["access"]


reader = login("reader1@library.local")
admin = login("admin@library.local")

status, page = request("GET", "/books/?page=1", reader)
check("Список книг доступен читателю", status == 200 and page["count"] == 20, page.get("count"))
first = page["results"][0]
check("В списке есть год издания", isinstance(first.get("year"), int), first.get("year"))

today = date.today()
status, availability = request(
    "GET",
    f"/books/{first['id']}/availability/?start_date={today}&due_date={today + timedelta(days=14)}",
    reader,
)
check(
    "Доступность отдаёт счётчики и экземпляры",
    status == 200 and availability["total_copies"] == len(availability["copies"]),
    f"{availability.get('free_copies')}/{availability.get('total_copies')}",
)

status, error = request(
    "GET",
    f"/books/{first['id']}/availability/?start_date={today - timedelta(days=1)}",
    reader,
)
check("Прошедшая дата отклоняется", status == 400 and error["code"] == "invalid_period", error.get("code"))

status, error = request(
    "POST", "/books/", reader, {"title": "Чужая", "author": "Автор", "genre": "Роман"}
)
check("Читатель не создаёт книгу", status == 403 and error["code"] == "forbidden", error.get("code"))

status, created = request(
    "POST",
    "/books/",
    admin,
    {
        "title": "Проверка API",
        "author": "Тест",
        "genre": "Роман",
        "year": 2020,
        "description": "Временная запись",
    },
)
check("Админ создаёт книгу с годом", status == 201 and created.get("year") == 2020, created.get("id"))

book_id = created["id"]
status, copy = request(
    "POST", f"/books/{book_id}/copies/", admin, {"inventory_number": "INV-CHECK-001"}
)
check("Админ добавляет экземпляр", status == 201, copy.get("inventory_number"))

status, patched = request(
    "PATCH", f"/books/{book_id}/copies/{copy['id']}/", admin, {"condition": "worn"}
)
check("Админ меняет состояние экземпляра", status == 200 and patched["condition"] == "worn")

status, deleted_copy = request("DELETE", f"/books/{book_id}/copies/{copy['id']}/", admin)
check("Экземпляр без истории удаляется", status == 204, status)

status, deleted_book = request("DELETE", f"/books/{book_id}/", admin)
check("Книга без истории удаляется", status == 204, status)

status, hidden = request("GET", "/books/?include_inactive=true", admin)
check("Админ видит неактивные книги", status == 200, hidden.get("count"))

status, error = request("GET", "/books/999999/", reader)
check("Неизвестная книга — 404 с кодом", status == 404 and error["code"] == "not_found", error.get("code"))

failed = checks.count(False)
print(f"\n{len(checks) - failed}/{len(checks)} проверок пройдено")
raise SystemExit(1 if failed else 0)

## Objective
- Продолжить учебный проект «Библиотека»: каталог почти закончен; теперь реализовать очередь бронирования (FIFO, удержание 48 ч), статусы броней и основные интерфейсы (`/my`, `/my/queue`, `/librarian`, бронирование на `/books/:id`).

## Requirements
- Backend: `POST /api/reservations/` — очередь; FIFO; запрет повторной активной заявки на книгу.
- При возврате: освободить экземпляр → первый `waiting` → `ready` + `hold_until = +48 ч`, всё в одной транзакции.
- Просроченное удержание → `expired`; следующий по очереди получает экземпляр при следующей проверке.
- `PATCH /api/loans/{id}/status/` с проверкой переходов через `loans/statuses.py`; недопустимый переход → `409`; статус + история + `activity_log` в одной транзакции.
- Reader видит только свои брони; librarian/admin — по ролям.
- Frontend: `/catalog`, `/books/:id` (страница книги и бронирование), `/my`, `/my/queue`, `/librarian` (выдача, возврат, очередь по книгам).
- Обязательно: состояния загрузки, ошибок и пустых списков; тесты очереди, возврата, удержания, статусов и прав; проверка полного сценария «нет книг → очередь → возврат → резерв первому».
- Ранее: не дублировать запросы в компонентах, CSS отдельно, простой аккуратный UI.
- Пользователь ранее просил сначала закончить каталог и не добавлять новые функции брони — теперь это разрешено и стало текущей задачей.

"""FIFO-очередь читателей и удержание экземпляров.

Порядок обслуживания: `ORDER BY created_at, id`. Все операции, меняющие
очередь, выполняются в транзакции и блокируют строку книги — иначе два
одновременных возврата могли бы выдать одно удержание двум читателям.
"""

from datetime import timedelta

from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone

from catalog.models import Book
from reservations.models import Reservation
from users.models import ActivityLog
from users.services import log_action

HOLD_HOURS = 48


class ReservationError(Exception):
    """Ошибка бизнес-правила очереди: код ответа и сообщение."""

    def __init__(self, detail, code, status_code=400):
        super().__init__(detail)
        self.detail = detail
        self.code = code
        self.status_code = status_code


@transaction.atomic
def create_reservation(*, reader, book_id, request=None):
    """Поставить читателя в очередь на книгу.

    Читатель всегда приходит из проверенного JWT. Повторная активная
    заявка на ту же книгу запрещена.
    """
    book = _lock_book(book_id, active_only=True)
    if book is None:
        raise ReservationError("Книга не найдена", "not_found", 404)

    expire_outdated_holds_locked(book)

    if Reservation.objects.filter(
        book=book,
        reader=reader,
        status__in=Reservation.ACTIVE_STATUSES,
    ).exists():
        raise ReservationError(
            "Вы уже стоите в очереди на эту книгу", "already_queued", 409
        )

    reservation = Reservation.objects.create(book=book, reader=reader)
    log_action(
        request,
        reader,
        ActivityLog.Action.RESERVATION_CREATED,
        description=f"Очередь на «{book.title}»",
        entity=reservation,
    )
    return reservation


def expire_outdated_holds(book_id):
    """Погасить просроченные удержания книги и передать экземпляры дальше.

    Фоновых задач нет, поэтому проверка выполняется при обращении к API.
    """
    with transaction.atomic():
        book = _lock_book(book_id)
        if book is None:
            return []
        return expire_outdated_holds_locked(book)


def expire_outdated_holds_locked(book):
    """Версия для вызова внутри уже открытой транзакции с блокировкой книги."""
    now = timezone.now()
    expired = list(
        Reservation.objects.select_for_update()
        .filter(book=book, status=Reservation.Status.READY, hold_until__lte=now)
        .order_by("created_at", "id")
    )

    for reservation in expired:
        copy = reservation.hold_copy
        reservation.status = Reservation.Status.EXPIRED
        reservation.save(update_fields=["status", "updated_at"])
        log_action(
            None,
            None,
            ActivityLog.Action.RESERVATION_EXPIRED,
            description=f"Удержание «{book.title}» истекло",
            entity=reservation,
        )
        if copy is not None:
            assign_hold_to_next(book, copy)

    return expired


def assign_hold_to_next(book, copy):
    """Отдать освободившийся экземпляр первому ожидающему.

    Вызывается внутри транзакции, которая уже заблокировала строку книги.
    """
    if copy is None:
        return None

    already_held = Reservation.objects.filter(

    ).exists()

        return None

    reservation = (
        Reservation.objects.select_for_update()
        .filter(book=book, status=Reservation.Status.WAITING)
        .order_by("created_at", "id")
        .first()
    )
    if reservation is None:
        return None

    reservation.status = Reservation.Status.READY
    reservation.hold_copy = copy
    reservation.hold_until = timezone.now() + timedelta(hours=HOLD_HOURS)
    reservation.save(
        update_fields=["status", "hold_copy", "hold_until", "updated_at"]
    )
    log_action(
        None,
        reservation.reader,
        ActivityLog.Action.RESERVATION_READY,
        description=(
            f"Экземпляр {copy.inventory_number} удержан за читателем "
            f"до {reservation.hold_until:%d.%m.%Y %H:%M}"
        ),
        entity=reservation,
    )
    return reservation


def fulfill_reservation(reader, book, request=None):
    """Закрыть заявку `ready`, когда читатель оформил бронь этой книги."""
    reservation = (
        Reservation.objects.select_for_update()
        .filter(book=book, reader=reader, status=Reservation.Status.READY)
        .order_by("created_at", "id")
        .first()
    )
    if reservation is None:
        return None

    reservation.status = Reservation.Status.FULFILLED
    reservation.hold_until = None
    reservation.save(update_fields=["status", "hold_until", "updated_at"])
    log_action(
        request,
        reader,
        ActivityLog.Action.RESERVATION_FULFILLED,
        description=f"Заявка на «{book.title}» выполнена",
        entity=reservation,
    )
    return reservation


def cancel_reservation(reservation_id, actor, request=None):
    """Отменить заявку: владелец или администратор.

    Если отменяется удержание, экземпляр сразу переходит следующему
    ожидающему.
    """
    target = (
        Reservation.objects.filter(pk=reservation_id)
        .values("id", "book_id", "reader_id")
        .first()
    )
    if target is None:
        raise ReservationError("Заявка не найдена", "not_found", 404)
    if target["reader_id"] != actor.id and actor.role != actor.Role.ADMIN:
        raise ReservationError("Заявка не найдена", "not_found", 404)

    with transaction.atomic():
        # Сначала книга, потом заявка — тот же порядок, что при возврате.
        book = _lock_book(target["book_id"])
        reservation = (
            Reservation.objects.select_for_update()
            .select_related("hold_copy")
            .filter(pk=reservation_id)
            .first()
        )
        if reservation is None or book is None:
            raise ReservationError("Заявка не найдена", "not_found", 404)
        if reservation.status not in Reservation.ACTIVE_STATUSES:
            raise ReservationError("Заявка уже закрыта", "bad_transition", 409)

        copy = reservation.hold_copy
        reservation.status = Reservation.Status.CANCELLED
        reservation.save(update_fields=["status", "updated_at"])
        log_action(
            request,
            actor,
            ActivityLog.Action.RESERVATION_CANCELLED,
            description=f"Заявка на «{book.title}» отменена",
            entity=reservation,
        )
        if copy is not None:
            assign_hold_to_next(book, copy)

    return reservation


def queue_position(reservation):
    """Позиция в очереди: 1 — следующий на обслуживание."""
    if reservation.status == Reservation.Status.WAITING:
        earlier = Reservation.objects.filter(
            book_id=reservation.book_id,
            status=Reservation.Status.WAITING,
        ).filter(
            Q(created_at__lt=reservation.created_at)
            | Q(created_at=reservation.created_at, id__lt=reservation.id)
        )
        return earlier.count() + 1
    if reservation.status == Reservation.Status.READY:
        return 1
    return None


def queue_state(book, reader=None):
    """Счётчики очереди и активная заявка читателя на книгу."""
    active = Reservation.objects.filter(
        book=book, status__in=Reservation.ACTIVE_STATUSES
    )
    my_reservation = None
    if reader is not None and getattr(reader, "is_authenticated", False):
        my_reservation = (
            active.filter(reader=reader).select_related("book").first()
        )
    return {
        "waiting_count": active.filter(status=Reservation.Status.WAITING).count(),
        "queue_length": active.count(),
        "my_reservation": my_reservation,
    }


def expire_reader_holds(reader):
    """Погасить просроченные удержания читателя перед выдачей его списка."""
    book_ids = (
        Reservation.objects.filter(
            reader=reader,
            status=Reservation.Status.READY,
            hold_until__lte=timezone.now(),
        )
        .values_list("book_id", flat=True)
        .distinct()
    )
    for book_id in list(book_ids):
        expire_outdated_holds(book_id)


def _lock_book(book_id, active_only=False):
    queryset = Book.objects.select_for_update()
    if active_only:
        queryset = queryset.filter(is_active=True)
    return queryset.filter(pk=book_id).first()

def _is_copy_busy(copy, start, due, reader):
    """Занят ли экземпляр: пересекающаяся бронь или чужое действующее удержание."""
    overlaps = Loan.objects.filter(
        copy=copy,
        status__in=BLOCKING_STATUSES,
        start_date__lt=due,
        due_date__gt=start,
    ).exists()
    if overlaps:
        return True

    return (
        Reservation.objects.filter(
            hold_copy=copy,
            status=Reservation.Status.READY,
            hold_until__gt=timezone.now(),
        )
        .exclude(reader=reader)
        .exists()
    )


def change_loan_status(*, loan_id, new_status, actor, request=None):
    """Сменить статус брони по матрице переходов.

    Статус, история и журнал пишутся в одной транзакции. Возврат
    (`active → returned`) освобождает экземпляр и передаёт удержание
    первому ожидающему в очереди.
    """
    with transaction.atomic():
        loan = (
            Loan.objects.select_for_update()
            .select_related("copy__book")
            .filter(pk=loan_id)
            .first()
        )
        if loan is None:
            raise LoanError("Бронь не найдена", "not_found", 404)

        _ensure_status_allowed(loan, new_status, actor)

        if not can_transition(loan.status, new_status):
            raise LoanError(
                "Недопустимый переход статуса: "
                f"«{_status_label(loan.status)}» → «{_status_label(new_status)}»",
                "bad_transition",
                409,
            )

        book = None
        if new_status == LoanStatus.RETURNED:
            # Возврат и выдача удержания — одна транзакция с блокировкой книги.
            book = Book.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=loan.copy.book_id)

        old_status = loan.status
        loan.status = new_status
        loan.save(update_fields=["status", "updated_at"])
        LoanStatusHistory.objects.create(
            loan=loan,
            old_status=old_status,
            new_status=new_status,
            changed_by=actor,
        )
        log_action(
            request,
            actor,
            ActivityLog.Action.LOAN_STATUS_CHANGED,
            description=(
                f"Бронь «{loan.copy.book.title}»: "
                f"{_status_label(old_status)} → {_status_label(new_status)}"
            ),
            entity=loan,
        )

        if new_status == LoanStatus.RETURNED:
            expire_outdated_holds_locked(book)
            assign_hold_to_next(book, loan.copy)

        return loan


def _ensure_status_allowed(loan, new_status, actor):
    """Проверить право роли на выбранный переход."""
    if actor.role == User.Role.READER:
        if loan.reader_id != actor.id:
            # Чужой объект не раскрываем.
            raise LoanError("Бронь не найдена", "not_found", 404)
        if new_status != LoanStatus.CANCELLED:
            raise LoanError(
                "Читатель может только отменить свою бронь", "forbidden", 403
            )


def _status_label(status):
    labels = dict(LoanStatus.choices)
    return labels.get(status, status)

"""Очередь: постановка, FIFO-позиция, дубли и права."""

from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.test import APITestCase

from catalog.tests.utils import AuthMixin, make_book, make_copy, make_hold, make_user
from reservations.models import Reservation
from users.models import User

RESERVATIONS_URL = "/api/reservations/"
MY_URL = "/api/reservations/my/"


class ReservationCreateTests(AuthMixin, APITestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.book = make_book(title="Книга очереди")
        self.copy = make_copy(self.book)
        self.reader = make_user("reader@test.local")
        self.other = make_user("other@test.local")
        self.librarian = make_user("librarian@test.local", role=User.Role.LIBRARIAN)
        self.admin = make_user("admin@test.local", role=User.Role.ADMIN)
        self.authenticate(self.reader)

    def join(self, book_id=None):
        return self.client.post(
            RESERVATIONS_URL,
            {"book_id": book_id or self.book.id},
            format="json",
        )

    def test_first_waiting_has_position_one(self):
        response = self.join()

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["status"], Reservation.Status.WAITING)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["position"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["reader_id"], self.reader.id)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["book"]["id"], self.book.id)
        self.assertEqual(Reservation.objects.count(), 1)

    def test_queue_is_fifo(self):
        self.join()
        self.authenticate(self.other)

        response = self.join()

        self.assertEqual(response.data["position"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(
            list(
                Reservation.objects.order_by("created_at", "id").values_list(
                    "reader__email", flat=True
                )
            ),
            ["reader@test.local", "other@test.local"],
        )

    def test_duplicate_active_reservation_returns_409(self):
        self.join()

        response = self.join()

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "already_queued")
        self.assertEqual(Reservation.objects.count(), 1)

    def test_ready_reservation_also_blocks_duplicate(self):
        make_hold(self.book, self.copy, self.reader)

        response = self.join()

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "already_queued")

    def test_cancelled_reservation_allows_new_one(self):
        first = self.join()
        self.client.delete(f"{RESERVATIONS_URL}{first.data['id']}/")

        response = self.join()

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(Reservation.objects.count(), 2)

    def test_unknown_book_returns_404(self):
        response = self.join(book_id=999999)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "not_found")

    def test_inactive_book_returns_404(self):
        self.book.is_active = False
        self.book.save(update_fields=["is_active"])

        response = self.join()

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "not_found")

    def test_anonymous_cannot_join_queue(self):
        self.client.credentials()

        response = self.join()

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)
        self.assertFalse(Reservation.objects.exists())

    def test_librarian_cannot_join_queue(self):
        self.authenticate(self.librarian)

        response = self.join()

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)
        self.assertFalse(Reservation.objects.exists())

    def test_reader_cannot_use_staff_list(self):
        response = self.client.get(RESERVATIONS_URL)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)

    def test_staff_sees_all_reservations(self):
        self.join()
        self.authenticate(self.other)
        self.join()

        self.authenticate(self.librarian)
        response = self.client.get(RESERVATIONS_URL)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 2)

    def test_admin_sees_all_reservations(self):
        self.join()
        self.authenticate(self.admin)

        response = self.client.get(RESERVATIONS_URL)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 1)


class ReservationMyListTests(AuthMixin, APITestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.book = make_book(title="Книга моей очереди")
        self.copy = make_copy(self.book)
        self.reader = make_user("reader@test.local")
        self.other = make_user("other@test.local")
        self.authenticate(self.reader)

    def test_my_list_returns_only_own_reservations(self):
        Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.reader)
        Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.other)

        response = self.client.get(MY_URL)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["results"][0]["reader_id"], self.reader.id)

    def test_my_list_requires_reader(self):
        self.authenticate(make_user("librarian@test.local", role=User.Role.LIBRARIAN))

        response = self.client.get(MY_URL)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN)


class ReservationCancelTests(AuthMixin, APITestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.book = make_book(title="Книга отмены")
        self.copy = make_copy(self.book)
        self.reader = make_user("reader@test.local")
        self.other = make_user("other@test.local")
        self.admin = make_user("admin@test.local", role=User.Role.ADMIN)
        self.authenticate(self.reader)

    def cancel(self, reservation_id):
        return self.client.delete(f"{RESERVATIONS_URL}{reservation_id}/")

    def test_owner_cancels_waiting_reservation(self):
        reservation = Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.reader)

        response = self.cancel(reservation.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
        reservation.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(reservation.status, Reservation.Status.CANCELLED)

    def test_reader_cannot_cancel_foreign_reservation(self):
        reservation = Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.other)

        response = self.cancel(reservation.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND)
        reservation.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(reservation.status, Reservation.Status.WAITING)

    def test_admin_cancels_foreign_reservation(self):
        reservation = Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.other)
        self.authenticate(self.admin)

        response = self.cancel(reservation.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)

    def test_cancel_ready_hold_gives_copy_to_next(self):
        first = make_hold(self.book, self.copy, self.reader)
        second = Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.other)

        response = self.cancel(first.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
        second.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(second.status, Reservation.Status.READY)
        self.assertEqual(second.hold_copy, self.copy)
        self.assertIsNotNone(second.hold_until)

    def test_cannot_cancel_terminal_reservation(self):
        reservation = Reservation.objects.create(
            book=self.book,
            reader=self.reader,
            status=Reservation.Status.CANCELLED,
        )

        response = self.cancel(reservation.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT)
        self.assertEqual(response.data["code"], "bad_transition")

    def test_anonymous_cannot_cancel(self):
        reservation = Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.reader)
        self.client.credentials()

        response = self.cancel(reservation.id)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)

from datetime import timedelta

from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework import status
from rest_framework.test import APITestCase

from catalog.tests.utils import (
    AuthMixin,
    make_book,
    make_copy,
    make_hold,
    make_loan,
    make_user,
)
from loans.models import Loan, LoanStatusHistory
from loans.statuses import LoanStatus
from reservations.models import Reservation
from reservations.services import HOLD_HOURS
from users.models import ActivityLog, User

LOANS_URL = "/api/loans/"
BOOKS_URL = "/api/books/"


class ReturnAndHoldTests(AuthMixin, APITestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.today = timezone.localdate()
        self.book = make_book(title="Книга удержания")
        self.copy = make_copy(self.book)
        self.owner = make_user("owner@test.local")
        self.first = make_user("first@test.local")
        self.second = make_user("second@test.local")
        self.librarian = make_user("librarian@test.local", role=User.Role.LIBRARIAN)
        self.active_loan = make_loan(
            self.copy,
            self.owner,
            self.today - timedelta(days=2),
            self.today + timedelta(days=5),
            status=LoanStatus.ACTIVE,
        )
        self.authenticate(self.librarian)

    def change_status(self, loan, new_status):
        return self.client.patch(
            f"{LOANS_URL}{loan.id}/status/",
            {"status": new_status},
            format="json",
        )

    def availability(self, reader):
        self.authenticate(reader)
        return self.client.get(f"{BOOKS_URL}{self.book.id}/availability/")

    def test_return_makes_first_waiting_ready_for_48_hours(self):
        first = Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.first)
        second = Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.second)

        response = self.change_status(self.active_loan, LoanStatus.RETURNED)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.active_loan.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.active_loan.status, LoanStatus.RETURNED)

        first.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(first.status, Reservation.Status.READY)
        self.assertEqual(first.hold_copy, self.copy)
        self.assertIsNotNone(first.hold_until)
        delta = first.hold_until - timezone.now()
        self.assertGreater(delta, timedelta(hours=HOLD_HOURS - 1))
        self.assertLessEqual(delta, timedelta(hours=HOLD_HOURS))

        second.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(second.status, Reservation.Status.WAITING)

    def test_return_writes_history_and_activity_log(self):
        Reservation.objects.create(book=self.book, reader=self.first)

        self.change_status(self.active_loan, LoanStatus.RETURNED)

        history = LoanStatusHistory.objects.filter(loan=self.active_loan).latest(
            "created_at"
        )
        self.assertEqual(history.old_status, LoanStatus.ACTIVE)
        self.assertEqual(history.new_status, LoanStatus.RETURNED)
        self.assertEqual(history.changed_by, self.librarian)

        log = ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            action=ActivityLog.Action.LOAN_STATUS_CHANGED,
            entity_type="loan",
            entity_id=self.active_loan.id,
        ).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(log)
        self.assertEqual(log.user, self.librarian)

        ready_log = ActivityLog.objects.filter(
            action=ActivityLog.Action.RESERVATION_READY
        ).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(ready_log)
        self.assertEqual(ready_log.user, self.first)

    def test_return_without_queue_keeps_copy_free(self):
        response = self.change_status(self.active_loan, LoanStatus.RETURNED)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        self.assertFalse(
            Reservation.objects.filter(status=Reservation.Status.READY).exists()
        )

    def test_expired_hold_moves_to_next_on_availability_check(self):
        expired = make_hold(
            self.book,
            self.copy,
            self.first,
            hold_until=timezone.now() - timedelta(hours=1),
        )
        next_in_queue = Reservation.objects.create(
            book=self.book, reader=self.second
        )

        response = self.availability(self.owner)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        expired.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(expired.status, Reservation.Status.EXPIRED)
        next_in_queue.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(next_in_queue.status, Reservation.Status.READY)
        self.assertEqual(next_in_queue.hold_copy, self.copy)
        self.assertGreater(next_in_queue.hold_until, timezone.now())

    def test_expired_hold_does_not_move_without_waiting(self):
        expired = make_hold(
            self.book,
            self.copy,
            self.first,
            hold_until=timezone.now() - timedelta(hours=1),
        )

        response = self.availability(self.owner)

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, status.HTTP_200_OK)
        expired.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(expired.status, Reservation.Status.EXPIRED)
        self.assertFalse(
            Reservation.objects.filter(status=Reservation.Status.READY).exists()
        )

    def test_full_scenario_queue_return_hold_and_fulfillment(self):
        # 1. Свободных экземпляров нет, первый читатель встаёт в очередь.
        self.authenticate(self.first)
        queue_response = self.client.post(
            "/api/reservations/", {"book_id": self.book.id}, format="json"
        )
        self.assertEqual(queue_response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        self.assertEqual(queue_response.data["position"], 1)

        # 2. Второй читатель — за ним.
        self.authenticate(self.second)
        second_queue = self.client.post(
            "/api/reservations/", {"book_id": self.book.id}, format="json"
        )
        self.assertEqual(second_queue.data["position"], 2)

        # 3. Библиотекарь принимает возврат: экземпляр уходит первому.
        self.authenticate(self.librarian)
        self.change_status(self.active_loan, LoanStatus.RETURNED)
        first_reservation = Reservation.objects.get(
            book=self.book, reader=self.first
        )
        self.assertEqual(first_reservation.status, Reservation.Status.READY)
        self.assertEqual(first_reservation.hold_copy, self.copy)

        # 4. Первый оформляет бронь на удержанный экземпляр.
        self.authenticate(self.first)
        start = self.today
        due = self.today + timedelta(days=10)
        loan_response = self.client.post(
            LOANS_URL,
            {
                "copy_id": self.copy.id,
                "start_date": start.isoformat(),
                "due_date": due.isoformat(),
            },
            format="json",
        )
        self.assertEqual(loan_response.status_code, status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
        first_reservation.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(first_reservation.status, Reservation.Status.FULFILLED)

        # 5. Возврат этой брони передаёт удержание второму читателю.
        first_loan = Loan.objects.get(pk=loan_response.data["id"])
        self.authenticate(self.librarian)
        self.change_status(first_loan, LoanStatus.RETURNED)

        second_reservation = Reservation.objects.get(
            book=self.book, reader=self.second
        )
        self.assertEqual(second_reservation.status, Reservation.Status.READY)
        self.assertEqual(second_reservation.hold_copy, self.copy)
